text:
The dish is a bowl of roughly 20 cm across, holding chopped chicken or tofu on a bed of greens and broccoli. The pieces are cubed and heaped fairly high.

I estimate about 150 g of chicken or tofu, 40 g of greens, and 30 g of broccoli, for roughly 220 g in total.

For energy, 150 g of chicken breast is about 250 kcal. If it is tofu, it would be closer to 150-200 kcal. The greens and broccoli add about 20 kcal, and I'm allowing a little for oil. That comes to about 270 kcal.
